text: The Chair and Co-Chair of the Film, Television and Digital Media Board will provide opening remarks and a high-level review of the updates to Spotlight on Toronto.

The Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board: 1. Confirmed its support for the Future Strategic Priorities, as set out in the document "Spotlight on Toronto - 2021 Review and Updates" (November 2021 - Item FB10.1). 2. Recommends that the Economic and Community Development Committee recommend that: 1. City Council approve the updates to "Spotlight on Toronto: A Strategic Action Plan for the Film, Television and Digital Media Industry" approved by City Council on July 4, 2017 [2017.ED22.4], set out in the document "Spotlight on Toronto - 2021 Review and Updates" (Item FB10.1) under "Possible Future Strategic Priorities", and with the following additional strategic priorities: a. Under Part 3 – Exceptional Customer Service Enhancements: - Complete technical application to ensure smooth implementation of the new film permit fees to support expansion of customer service initiatives.…
